title: Bayezid II Mosque
visualBrief: Individual Bayezid II Mosque compound: retained stepped envelope and open court,pale limestone walls,red/cream arch bands,rectangular ground windows and pointed upper screens,real courtyard arcades with stone columns,domed gallery roofs,entrance portals,covered polygonal fountain,central gray lead dome and paired semi-domes,lower side cupolas and two widely separated slender minarets with open balconies and conical gray caps. Adjacent library,bazaar,tombs,garden,fence,vehicles,inscriptions,exact ornament,furnished interiors and engineering are excluded.
